name: Shirohebi-sama
source:
A younger member of the ancient Shirohebi clan, she is not yet in service to anyone when Primtine's castle moves through clan territory. Primtine has unwittingly violated an ancient agreement that prevents anyone from entering Shirohebi territory, an affront which riles the Shirohebi clan and drives them to attack the castle in retaliation.

[Spoiler] All Shirohebi possess strong magic resistance, so Fabio is forced to rely on his technique alone to break Shirohebi's resistance and force her to work for him. Although she is talented like the rest of her kin, she is immature and slightly spoiled by her upbringing which makes it difficult for her to ask Fabio directly for sex as a reward for good work.

In her end, she returns to her kin and boasts about her achievements in Primtine's army. She gets a little carried away doing so and eventually makes the decision to tell her parents that she wishes to serve under Fabio on a lifetime basis, which is apparently a major decision for Shirohebi and isn't to be taken lightly... [/Spoiler]
